title: Son of Jackass: Grand and Final
original_title: Son of Jackass: Grand and Final
overview: Christian Rogers and the gang return for one final fling at the big screen. Featuring all-new stunts and stupidity along with the greatest hits and biggest laughs from the past, Son of Jackass: Grand and Final is a joyously raucous celebration of all the mischievous camaraderie that you've come to love and expect from these idiots over the past 5 years. So, grab your dumb little buddies, raise your glasses, and come experience the cinematic event that promises to be the last time you'll ever laugh this hard in a theatre.
